name: Build a reader persona and print specifications from your social media audience with an AI agent
description: Profiles the people who like, comment, share and follow, then turns that profile into a reader persona and concrete print specifications for the book.
shortDescription: Profile the people who engage with your posts and turn that into a reader persona and book specs.
keyFeatures: AI market researcher that profiles the people who like, comment, share and follow
Reader persona with concrete print specifications: format, binding, paper and price range
Writes the profile to a Google Doc
prerequisites: Google Sheets and Google Docs connections
A spreadsheet with your exported audience data; replace REPLACE_WITH_SOCIAL_EXPORT_SPREADSHEET_ID
idealFor: Authors and small publishers deciding what kind of book their audience will actually buy.
steps: Read the audience export from Google Sheets.
The market researcher agent builds a reader persona and print specifications.
Write the profile to a new Google Doc.
